crossRefs.note: All the country of Judea and all those of Jerusalem went out to him. They were baptized by him in the Jordan river…
The next Sabbath, almost the whole city was gathered together to hear the word of God.

translations.web: All the city was gathered together at the door.
translations.bsb: and the whole town gathered at the door.
translations.kjv: And all the city was gathered together at the door.
translations.asv: And all the city was gathered together at the door.
